header.title: Fabulae Aesopeae: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Babrius
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's tlg0614.tlg001.1st1K-grc2, from Open Greek and Latin's First1KGreek (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY-SA 4.0, as its source requires: credit Open Greek and Latin's First1KGreek and this AI translation, and share adaptations under the same licence.

notes.urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0614.tlg001.1st1K-gr: Ζλεὺς in 58.1 is a misprint for Ζεὺς, Zeus.

nodes.text: emptied it, and did not let it go on to other
people any further, though there were [other] people.
From then on the Arabs are, as I have found by experience,
liars and charlatans, on whose tongue
not one word of truth sits.
Zeus, having gathered all good things together in a jar,
put a lid on it and set it beside a man.
